notes: IEEE 1516.1-2025 has no separate whole-class subscribeObjectClass service. This scenario uses subscribeObjectClassAttributes with every ordinary attribute in the adapter-selected class and active=false. Completeness is a property of the adapter's FOM fixture; the normative service remains the standard attribute-set subscription API. No DDM region behavior is covered.

requirements.statement: The subject federate subscribes passively to the complete adapter-configured object-class attribute handle set through the standard attribute-set service. The requester verifies that the standard MIM report identifies the class, reports active=false, preserves the configured update-rate designator, and contains exactly the subscribed handles.

The requester queries the joined subject through the standard MIM and verifies that the object-class subscription report returns the selected class, passive state, update-rate designator, and exact attribute-handle list. Attribute and object-class handles are decoded with public RTIambassador services.
